CVE-2026-124040.title: CivetWeb through 1.16, when built with USE_HTTP2 and enable_http2 ...
CVE-2026-124040.description: CivetWeb through 1.16, when built with USE_HTTP2 and enable_http2 on, contains a use-after-free vulnerability in handle_http2() that retains freed :method and :path pointers. Unauthenticated remote attackers can send a later HEADERS frame omitting these pseudo-headers to influence request method or path seen by access rules, or crash the server.

CVE-2026-135690.title: CivetWeb through 1.16 built with USE_HTTP2 and enable_http2 conta ...
CVE-2026-135690.description: CivetWeb through 1.16 built with USE_HTTP2 and enable_http2 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in hpack_decode() in src/http2.inl. Unauthenticated remote attackers can send a crafted HEADERS frame ending with a Huffman-coded string over TLS-negotiated HTTP/2 to read one byte past the heap frame buffer.
